claim: Major frontier-AI leaders are publicly converging on stronger external evaluation and coordinated safety controls as model capability advances.
verifiedFacts: Reuters reported Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calling for slower advanced-model development and proposing independent evaluators, coordinated safety standards, and international cooperation; OpenAI CEO Sam Altman publicly supported the concern.
inference: Governed external evaluation is becoming an operating requirement rather than an optional AI-safety narrative.
Consultancy: independent evaluation boundary design, evidence capture, and stop-gate architecture.
Disposition: Seed Loom CORE; Agent Runtime PRODUCTIZE only where execution receipts and permissions are required.
significance: This strengthens the business case for inspectable evaluator access, explicit stop gates, and evidence-backed promotion decisions in advanced agent systems.
assumptions: Public safety commitments will translate into durable evaluation interfaces and operational controls.
knownLimitations: The proposal is partly voluntary and coordination mechanisms are not yet standardized or independently measured.
